# The content-sized rows example wraps real text, not random words

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

Row 10 of the Grid & Table slate ([#21142](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6924949418)), a leaf of #21175 (the Grid & Table group, under #21140).

## The Problem

`examples/grid/contentSizedRows` proves that a grid of 10,000 rows can make each row as tall as its longest wrapped text, with pinned columns on both sides. Its cells hold random words, so the frame reads as filler and a visitor cannot tell wrapped text from noise. The issues grid has the same switch on real text; this card is where a visitor finds the feature by name, and it should look at least as convincing.

## The Architectural Reality

- `examples/grid/contentSizedRows/`: `MainContainer.mjs` (109 lines; its `@summary` at `:10` says what it proves; a toolbar with the switch at `:37`, "Jump to row" at `:44` and "Filter summary" at `:54`; the columns from `:70`, with `wrapText: true` on Title and Summary and pinned columns at the start), `MainStore.mjs` (131 lines; `amountRows_: 10000` at `:35`, `generateData()` at `:87`), `MainModel.mjs`.
- Both themes are in `neo-config.json`.
- `test/playwright/e2e/grid/ContentSizedRowsExample.spec.mjs` drives the example, and `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/fixtures/e2eSelectionReplay.json` names its folder.
- Catalog record `grid-content-sized-rows`.
- The example came from #19666, which kept tree stores, images, components and remote data out.
- Design authority: "Every renew and every new row is then filed as its own leaf under #21140" (#21142), row 10 of its Grid & Table table; the bar is the one #21140 names: "an example resets, works at phone width, in both themes, by keyboard".

## The Fix

1. **Text a person would read**, for example support tickets, review notes or change log entries: a title, a summary of one to four sentences and notes of varying length, composed from a pool of real sentences.
2. **The same rows on every load.** The generator is seeded, so the spec and the cover are stable.
3. The 10,000 rows, the switch, the jump field and the filter stay.
4. One line in the frame names the proof, for example "10,000 rows, each as tall as its text."

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every wrapped cell holds a readable sentence or paragraph; no cell is a run of unrelated words.
- [ ] In the first frame at 1440 × 900 at least three different row heights show.
- [ ] Two loads produce identical rows.
- [ ] Jumping to row 9,000 and filtering the summary still work, and the PR gives the time from a jump to a painted row as measured in a browser.
- [ ] `npm run test-e2e -- test/playwright/e2e/grid/ContentSizedRowsExample.spec.mjs` passes, adapted where it pins the old text.
- [ ] 390 × 844; both themes.
- [ ] **Look:** the first frame at both sizes, with the switch on and off, is on the PR beside today's frame, and the design seat reads it before code review.
- [ ] The catalog cover is re-shot from the new default state with the producer of #20679, or the PR names the change that brings it.

## Out of Scope

Changes to row sizing in the grid; images or components in cells (#19666 kept them out); the issues grid.

## Avoided Traps

- **Lorem ipsum.** It is filler too, and a visitor reads it as unfinished.
- **A data file of 10,000 rows in the repository.** The rows are generated from a small pool.

## Related

Parent #21175 · the slate #21142 · #21140 · #19666 (the example's origin, closed) · #19756 (the issues grid, closed) · #20500 (the family's captions, closed).
